visible_state.retention: Wrist view shows the card between gripper components, with a pad overlapping its PCB face. Retention appears maintained, but a single frame cannot establish grip security or exclude slip.
visible_state.placement: Right view exposes the gold connector above a reinforced motherboard socket. Their projected directions are broadly similar; longitudinal registration and connector-notch/socket-key correspondence are not established.
visible_state.target_identity: The visible socket is plausibly the CPU-adjacent target. Occlusion and the neighboring parallel slot leave possible misassociation; historical sample coordinates do not resolve it.

next_stage: Inspection: keep the hand stationary and aperture at 0.3. Obtain a closer oblique/top-down observation resolving the connector's short section and notch against the selected socket's key/end housing, while checking pad-to-card retention. Do not lower or translate along the socket yet.
